name: Zanopy: Landing Page Creator
author: Zanopy

sections.description:
Zanopy: Landing Page Creator connects your WooCommerce store to the Zanopy marketing platform (https://zanopy.ai). Automatically sync products, pages, and themes. Publish high-converting landing pages directly from HTML designs.

This plugin acts as an interface to Zanopy services.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Connect – Zero configuration. Install plugin and your store is ready
  • Product Sync – Import all WooCommerce products with categories and stock status
  • Landing Page Publisher – Publish as WordPress pages or reusable templates
  • Theme Integration – Import active theme and all available themes
  • Merchant Automation – Configure automated email and WhatsApp notifications based on store activity
  • Secure Authentication – HMAC signature-based authentication (no API keys needed)
  • Privacy First – All customer data is encrypted before transmission

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin from WordPress plugin directory
  2. Your store automatically registers with Zanopy platform
  3. Access Zanopy dashboard to import products and publish pages
  4. Generate Your Landing pages on Zanopy and Click on ‘Publish’ to publish the page on your existing woocommerce site
  5. Connect Facebook pixel id and conversion pixel to the Landing Page to monitor and optimise to ads
  6. Track sales and customer behavior in real-time

Privacy Policy: https://zanopy.ai/privacy-wordpress-plugin.html
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Zanopy Landing Page Creator”
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. The plugin automatically connects to Zanopy platform
  5. Visit Zanopy dashboard to manage your store

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/zanopy-landing-page-creator/
  3. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  4. The plugin auto-registers your store
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for full functionality.

Is there any configuration needed?

No. The plugin auto-registers your store on activation. Zero setup required.

How does authentication work?

The plugin uses HMAC signatures for secure communication. No API keys or passwords are stored.

Can I disconnect my store?

Yes, you can disconnect anytime from the plugin settings page or Zanopy dashboard.

What data is collected?

Product information, page content, theme details, and order events. Customer email and phone are encrypted for merchant-configured automation workflows. See our Privacy Policy for complete details.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communications use HMAC signatures. No passwords or API keys are stored in the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Re-enabled block checkout tracker as the primary early-capture source for abandoned cart automation
  • Added Store API order-processed enrichment so checkout leads are fully populated before payment
  • Receiver now merges checkout leads instead of replacing them, preserving the most complete data across multiple capture attempts
  • Fixed missing address, first name, and last name fields in checkout lead records

1.0.7

  • Disabled client-side checkout tracker in favor of server-side Store API capture for more reliable block checkout data
  • Fixed missing phone, address, first name, and last name in checkout leads for merchant automation
  • Improved change detection so partial checkout captures are overwritten when complete details arrive

1.0.6

  • Fixed abandoned cart automation for WooCommerce block checkout
  • Checkout form updates now trigger automation with email, phone, and address
  • Added JavaScript checkout tracker for block-based checkout compatibility

1.0.5

  • Checkout form updates now trigger abandoned cart automation with email/phone/address
  • Improved checkout lead deduplication to avoid duplicate automation messages
  • Abandoned cart automation now fires only when checkout details are available

1.0.4

  • Added support for Zanopy template ID tracking on published landing pages
  • Order, checkout, and cart webhooks now include the landing page template ID for merchant automation triggers
  • Improved landing page attribution for automation workflows

1.0.3

  • Your store now automatically creates or links your Zanopy account during setup
  • View your connected Zanopy account details directly from the plugin settings page
  • One-click button to open your Zanopy dashboard

1.0.2

  • Fixed template update endpoint to accept WordPress block template IDs (theme//slug format) and plain slugs

1.0.1

  • Added template update endpoint (PUT /templates/{id}) to support republishing HTML templates

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Auto-registration with Zanopy platform
  • Product, page, and theme sync
  • Landing page publishing from HTML
  • Order webhook tracking
